text_runs: A DREAM.

I AM DREAMING. A DREAM
IN WHICH I TREMBLE

ALONE IN A DARK ROOM,
CLUTCHING MYSELF.

IN A DIM, LIGHTLESS
ROOM, I CURL UP WITH MY
KNEES HUGGED TO MY

CHEST ON THE COLD WOODEN
FLOOR, BEADS OF SWEAT
FORMING ACROSS MY

ENTIRE BODY AS I
DESPERATELY TRY

TO SUPPRESS 「SOMETHING」
TRYING TO

CRAWL OUT FROM WITHIN MY
HEART. THAT IS THE KIND OF DREAM I HAVE.

HAA, HAA... BREATHING
LIKE A WILD

CARNIVORE. MY WHOLE BODY
TREMBLES,

AND SWEAT CONTINUES TO
POUR DOWN.

MY CHEST FEELS TIGHT. MY
HEAD

THROBS AS IF IT MIGHT
SPLIT OPEN.

SOMEONE−SOMEONE, PLEASE
HELP ME.

MY LIPS FORMED THE SHAPE
OF WORDS,

BUT NO SOUND CAME OUT.
SOMEONE...

…HEH HEH HEH. …HOW LONG
DO

YOU PLAN ON STAYING LIKE
THAT?

A STIFLED LAUGH ECHOED
IN MY HEAD.
…USELESS.
…USELESS. …IT・S
USELESS. …YOU
CANNOT PIN ME DOWN.

SHUT UP! I SCREAMED. IF
I

LET MY GUARD DOWN FOR
EVEN

A MOMENT, 「HE」 WOULD
BREAK THROUGH THE CAGE
CALLED
REASON AND SPRING OUT AT

ANY SECOND. MY
FINGERNAILS

DUG INTO MY KNEES. I
COULD NOT AFFORD TO LOSE.

…HEH HEH HEH, YOU
CERTAINLY

WIN TONIGHT. …BUT WHAT
ABOUT

TOMORROW? …AND THE DAY
AFTER? …FOR EXAMPLE,
JUST HOW
LONG COULD YOU POSSIBLY

ENDURE−WITHOUT FOOD,
WITHOUT

WATER, WITHOUT SLEEP?
…IT・S

THE SAME THING.
…ESPECIALLY...
SHUT UP!

…HEH HEH HEH, DEEP DOWN
YOU KNOW IT TOO,

DO NOT YOU? …THAT YOU・VE
REACHED YOUR

LIMIT. …THAT YOU CANNOT
BEAR IT ANY

LONGER. …NOW, BREAK
FREE. …SET YOURSELF

FREE. …TOMORROW WILL
JUST BECOME

TODAY, AND THE DAY AFTER
TOMORROW WILL

BECOME TODAY. …IF THAT・S
THE CASE, IS

NOT IT JUST A WASTE TO
SUFFER? …RIGHT?

NO. NO, NO, NO! NO
MATTER WHAT, I MUST
NOT LET 「HIM」 GO FREE!
THE ONLY RESISTANCE

I CAN MUSTER... IS TO
KEEP 「HIM」 LOCKED

AWAY IN THE CAGE CALLED
REASON...

…YES, INTO A CRACKED
CAGE, ON THE VERGE OF
BREAKING…
SHUT UP! SHUT UP,
SHUT UP, SHUT UP!

…HEH HEH HEH. …HA HA HA
HA
HA HA!
…AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!

MORNING! IS MORNING
STILL

FAR OFF? WHEN MORNING
COMES,

I SHALL WIN. 「IT」
SLEEPS.

「IT」 CAN ONLY AWAKEN AT
NIGHT.

ONCE THE MORNING LIGHT
BEGINS TO FILTER THROUGH
THE
GAPS IN THE CURTAINS, 「IT」

WILL FALL ASLEEP ONCE
MORE.

…BUT ONCE THE SUN SETS…
IT WILL AWAKEN AGAIN.
MORNING! IS MORNING
STILL FAR OFF?!

…TEARING THROUGH FLESH
AS SOFT AS FRUIT WITH MY
CLAWS, SLURPING WARM,
PULSING, BRIGHT RED

FRESH BLOOD, RAVISHING
FRAGRANT WOMEN TO

IMPREGNATE THEM, AND
THEN, ONCE AGAIN, OUR
BLOOD…

WHEN MORNING COMES,
「THIS THING」...!
…HEY, STOP CALLING ME

「THAT GUY」 OR 「THIS
GUY.」

…BECAUSE I AM 「YOU
YOURSELF.」
「IS MORNING HERE YET−!!」
「IS IT MORNING YET?!」
1. KEEP DREAMING.
2. WAKE UP.

WHAM! I BOLTED UPRIGHT
FROM

MY FUTON WITH SUDDEN
FORCE.

「KYAA!」 THE FIRST THING
THAT CAUGHT MY EYE AS I

OPENED MY EYELIDS WAS
THE FIGURE OF A WOMAN,
HER BODY

JERKING STIFF WITH
SURPRISE. HER LONG BLACK
HAIR

FLUTTERED, SLOWLY
SETTLING BACK OVER HER
SHOULDERS.

IT WAS AN UNFAMILIAR
ROOM. …A

CONTINUATION OF THE
DREAM? NO… THAT・S

NOT IT. THIS PLACE IS…
THE CONTENTS

OF MY MIND
GRADUALLY BEGAN TO STIR,

AND I FINALLY REALIZED I
HAD RETURNED

TO REALITY. THIS PLACE
IS… YES,
MY FATHER・S FAMILY HOME. I・D BEEN

STAYING THERE
FOR
THE PAST THREE DAYS.

I NARROWED MY EYES AT
THE DAZZLING LIGHT
STREAMING THROUGH THE
GAPS IN

THE OPEN SHOJI SCREENS.
IT WAS MORNING.

THE MORNING I HAD LONGED
FOR IN MY

DREAMS HAD ARRIVED−AND A
MORNING OF

REFRESHING BLUE SKIES,
NO LESS. THE

CHIRPING OF SMALL BIRDS
DRIFTED FROM

SOMEWHERE, ADDING COLOR
TO THE SERENE DAY.

「…P−PLEASE, DO NOT
STARTLE ME AGAIN,
KOICHI−SAN.」 THE WOMAN
BEFORE ME PLACED A HAND
AGAINST HER CHEST AND
LET OUT A DEEP SIGH. 「MY

HEART IS STILL
POUNDING.」 SHE SAID THIS
WITH

A WRY SMILE. SEEING HOW
HALF−ASLEEP I WAS,
I TOO GAVE A BASHFUL SMILE, AS IF TO HIDE MY

OWN EMBARRASSMENT.
「…G−GOOD MORNING.」 「GOOD

MORNING. THE WEATHER IS
LOVELY TODAY, TOO.」

HER NAME IS CHIZURU
KASHIWAGI. SHE・S MY

COUSIN, THREE YEARS MY
SENIOR AND TWENTY−THREE

YEARS OLD. DESPITE HER
YOUTH−HAVING JUST

GRADUATED FROM A CERTAIN
NATIONAL UNIVERSITY LAST

SPRING−SHE IS THE HEAD
OF THE PRESTIGIOUS

KASHIWAGI FAMILY. SHE・S
PROBABLY HERE TO WAKE ME

UP. SINCE I・D BOLTED
UPRIGHT FROM MY FUTON

IN MY HALF−ASLEEP STATE,
SHE SEEMED STARTLED.

HER LONG, LUSTROUS BLACK
HAIR CAUGHT THE MORNING

LIGHT, SHIMMERING
BRILLIANTLY. SHE WAS AS

STUNNING AS EVER−SO
BEAUTIFUL IT MADE MY
EYES

WIDEN. TYPICALLY, WOMEN
WITH SUCH LOVELY FACES
TEND

TO BE PERCEIVED AS COLD,
BUT STRANGELY, THIS

CHIZURU DID NOT GIVE OFF
EVEN THE SLIGHTEST HINT

OF THAT AURA. WITH HER
MANNERISMS AND
PERSONALITY,

CHIZURU WAS A LOVELY,
VERY GENTLE WOMAN.
「…WHY DID YOU JUMP UP IN

SUCH A PANIC… WHAT ON
EARTH

HAPPENED?」 CHIZURU
TILTED

HER HEAD SLIGHTLY,
NARROWED

HER EYES, AND GAVE A
LITTLE SMILE. 「N−NO…」
LOOKING

DOWN, I RUBBED MY SLEEPY
EYES

AND GAVE A BASHFUL
REPLY.

「DID YOU HAVE A SCARY
DREAM?」 A WARM

VOICE−THE KIND THAT
EVOKED THE IMAGE OF A

MOTHER YOU・D
INSTINCTIVELY WANT TO
LEAN

ON. IT WAS A GENTLE
TONE, BEFITTING HER

IMAGE. 「...U−UH, YEAH,
WELL...」 I LOOKED
UP, SMOOTHING DOWN THE BEDHEAD IN MY HAIR.

「FOR THE PAST TWO OR
THREE DAYS, I・VE

BEEN HAVING A SERIES OF
STRANGE DREAMS...」

YES, IN FACT, THIS IS
THE
THIRD TIME I・VE HAD THIS

DREAM. I HAD THE SAME
DREAM YESTERDAY, AND THE

DAY BEFORE, TOO. I HAVE
NEVER ONCE EXPERIENCED

THE SAME DREAM THREE
TIMES IN A ROW. NO... TO
BE

PRECISE, IT IS NOT
EXACTLY THE SAME DREAM.
THE

SITUATION HAS GROWN
INCREASINGLY SEVERE WITH
EACH

ITERATION, DAY BY DAY.
THAT 「THING」 IN MY HEART
IS GROWING STRONGER AND

MORE DISTINCT BY THE
DAY.

MOST LIKELY, AROUND THIS
TIME, I・LL LOSE CONTROL
OF

MY CONSCIOUSNESS. AND
WHEN THAT HAPPENS...
WHEN MY

CONSCIOUSNESS IS
SWALLOWED UP BY THAT
THING WITHIN THE

VIRTUAL REALITY OF A
DREAM...
JUST WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO ME?

…JUST KIDDING. AFTER
ALL, IT・S JUST A DREAM.

NOTHING IN PARTICULAR IS
BOUND TO HAPPEN. A

DREAM IS, AFTER ALL,
JUST A DREAM−NOT
REALITY.

BUT I OFTEN HEAR THINGS
LIKE, 「A DREAM IS A

MIRROR OF THE MIND,
REFLECTING THE
UNCONSCIOUS

SELF.」 WHICH MEANS HE・S
A MANIFESTATION OF MY

TRUE NATURE−IN OTHER
WORDS, SOMEWHERE IN MY

HEART, I MYSELF HAVE
THOSE KINDS OF
DESIRES...
「KOICHI−SAN.」 「WHOA!」
WHEN I SUDDENLY

LOOKED UP, I SAW
CHIZURU−SAN・S

LARGE EYES RIGHT IN
FRONT OF

ME. SEEING MY SURPRISE,
SHE WAS
GIGGLING. 「...WHAT
KIND OF STRANGE

DREAM IS IT?」
CHIZURU−SAN ASKED,

PERHAPS CONCERNED THAT I
WAS LOST

IN THOUGHT.
「HUH? THE CONTENT?」

「YES, DESPITE HOW I
LOOK, I・VE

DABBLED IN PSYCHOLOGY
MYSELF. WOULD

YOU LIKE
ME TO DIAGNOSE THE
CONTENTS

OF THAT STRANGE DREAM
YOU HAD,

KOICHI−SAN?」 CHIZURU−SAN
GAVE A MISCHIEVOUS
SMILE. I THINK THIS
CHILDLIKE INNOCENCE ALSO PLAYS A PART

IN MAKING HER SEEM SO
ENDEARING...

…THE CONTENTS OF THE
DREAM, HUH? THOSE EERIE
IMAGES

FLASH BACK THROUGH MY
MIND. IT WAS SUCH A
SINISTER

DREAM THAT IT DID NOT
SEEM LIKE I・D GET A
DIAGNOSIS

WITH ANY POSITIVE
IMPLICATIONS AT ALL. THE

LIKELY OUTCOME WOULD BE AN ANSWER ABOUT
FRUSTRATION,

OR SOME DESIRE OF
SORTS−THAT・S JUST HOW IT

WOULD PLAY OUT. STILL,
WITH THIS VOICE PRESSING
ME,

I FEEL AN IRRESISTIBLE
URGE TO SPILL
EVERYTHING.

LEFT WITH NO CHOICE,
I...
1. TELL MY DREAM.
2. JOKE THAT CHIZURU
WAS IN MY DREAM.
3. LAUGH IT OFF.

「…COME TO THINK OF IT, I
ONLY STARTED SEEING THIS

AFTER I CAME HERE...」
SINCE I HAD NO
PARTICULAR

REASON TO HIDE IT, I
BEGAN TO HONESTLY
RECOUNT

THE CONTENTS OF MY
DREAM. 「I WAS HUDDLING
IN

A DARK ROOM I・D NEVER SEEN BEFORE, TREMBLING
AND

SWEATING... THAT・S
PRETTY MUCH HOW IT
STARTED...」

「ARE YOU SUFFERING FROM
SOMETHING?」 IT SEEMED

CHIZURU−SAN HAD ALREADY
BEGUN HER DIAGNOSIS.
「…RIGHT. AS FOR WHY I
AM SUFFERING SO MUCH,
IT・S BECAUSE THERE・S
ANOTHER CONSCIOUSNESS

INSIDE ME, AND IT・S
TRYING TO BREAK FREE.

IT・S LIKE WE ARE
FIGHTING FOR CONTROL

OF MY CONSCIOUSNESS.
ANYWAY, THIS OTHER

GUY IS A BIT OF A
WEIRDO…」 「WEIRD?」 「HOW
SHOULD I PUT IT...
WELL, HE・S GOT... SOME

MACABRE TASTES, I
GUESS.」 「…MACABRE…?」

「RIGHT. THAT THING
FORCES ME TO DO

CRUEL
THINGS THAT MAKE ME
SICK−LIKE

SOMETHING STRAIGHT OUT
OF A B−MOVIE HORROR
FLICK...」 「...CRUEL?」

「THINGS LIKE TEARING
FLESH APART

OR SUCKING BLOOD... AND
JUDGING

BY THE WAY IT・S PHRASED, IT・S PROBABLY HUMAN.
ALSO, SOMETHING

THAT
SMELLS GOOD... N−NO,
C−COUGH.」

AFTER 「SOMETHING THAT
SMELLS

GOOD...」, THE
SENTENCE CONTINUED

WITH 「RAPING A WOMAN AND
GETTING

HER PREGNANT...」, BUT
THERE WAS NO WAY I COULD
SAY SUCH A THING

IN FRONT OF CHIZURU−SAN,
SO I

CLEARED MY THROAT TO
BRUSH IT OFF.

「WELL, IT・S JUST THAT
THESE KINDS OF CREEPY

THOUGHTS KEEP PLAYING
OVER
AND OVER IN MY HEAD...」

WAIT, WHAT? I GLANCED
OVER AND SAW CHIZURU−WHO

HAD BEEN ACTING A BIT
PLAYFUL JUST A MOMENT

AGO−NOW LOOKING DOWN
WITH A DARK EXPRESSION.
WHAT・S WRONG? ...UGH, MAYBE TALKING ABOUT MEAT

AND BLOOD FIRST THING IN
THE MORNING WAS TOO

HEAVY? I FEEL LIKE I・VE
REALLY PUT HER OFF.

「...O−OF COURSE, I AM
DESPERATELY TRYING

TO HOLD IT BACK, BUT
IT・S ALSO GRADUALLY

GAINING STRENGTH, SO TO
SPEAK...」 「I−IS THAT
SO!?」 WITH THAT,

CHIZURU−SAN SUDDENLY
LOOKED

UP. HER
EXPRESSION WAS THE VERY
PICTURE OF
SERIOUSNESS. W−WHAT? HER REACTION WAS FAR
MORE EXAGGERATED THAN
I EXPECTED. 「...STILL,
IT・S JUST A DREAM,」 I
SAID WITH A WRY SMILE.

「BESIDES, THIS IS A
FIRST

FOR ME−I・VE BEEN HAVING
THE

SAME DREAM FOR THREE
DAYS

STRAIGHT. AND... I AM
GRADUALLY

STARTING TO BE
PUSHED BACK... I FEEL
LIKE I AM BEING

CORNERED, AND FOR SOME
REASON, I JUST CANNOT
SEEM

TO WAKE UP...」 「......」
WITHOUT

SAYING A WORD,
CHIZURU−SAN

STARED INTENTLY AT MY
FACE, HER EXPRESSION ONE
OF
DEEP THOUGHT. 「UM...

CHIZURU−SAN?」 「HUH?」
CHIZURU−SAN

SNAPPED BACK TO HER
SENSES AND OPENED HER EYES WIDE.

「WHAT・S THE DIAGNOSIS?」
「UH, OH, YES, THAT・S
RIGHT. LET US SEE...」

SHE PLACED A HAND ON HER
LOWER JAW,

MAKING A
THOUGHTFUL GESTURE. 「UM,

LET US SEE. ACCORDING TO
FREUD,

DREAMS OCCUR WHEN A
PERSON・S LATENT

DESIRES
PASS THROUGH THE FILTER
OF THE EGO, TAKING ON A SYMBOLIC

FORM THAT THEN MANIFESTS
IN THE

SURFACE CONSCIOUSNESS.
SO, APPLYING

THAT...」 CHIZURU LIGHTLY
TAPPED

MY FOREHEAD WITH HER
INDEX FINGER.

「THAT MEANS KOICHI−SAN・S
LATENT
DESIRES AND REASON ARE CLASHING, HAVING

TAKEN ON DIFFERENT
FORMS.」 HMM−EXACTLY THE
ANSWER I HAD EXPECTED.

「SO, YOU ARE SAYING THAT
CREEPY GUY WITH THOSE

MACABRE TASTES IS
ACTUALLY MY TRUE SELF?」

「THAT・S RIGHT.」 「......」
NOW THAT IT・S BEEN PUT
SO BLUNTLY... 「DREAMS

ARE A MIRROR OF THE
MIND,

REFLECTING THE
UNCONSCIOUS SELF. IT
MIGHT ONLY

BE A MATTER OF TIME BEFORE
KOICHI−SAN REVEALS
HIS TRUE NATURE. I・LL

HAVE TO BE CAREFUL,
TOO.」

CHIZURU−SAN GAVE A
MISCHIEVOUS LITTLE
GIGGLE.

「ACTUALLY, IT WAS A
DREAM WHERE

CHIZURU−SAN APPEARED...」
I MUTTERED,

KEEPING MY HEAD DOWN AND
STARING

AT THE FUTON.
「...HUH? ME?」

SHE LOOKED BEWILDERED.
「YEAH,

IT WAS A REALLY SCARY
DREAM.」
AFTER A BRIEF PAUSE, CHIZURU−SAN

FINALLY UNDERSTOOD WHAT
I MEANT.

「...KOICHI−SAN! IS THE
DREAM I AM

HAVING SO
TERRIFYING
THAT IT MAKES ME

BOLT UPRIGHT!?」 I SHOT
HER A SHARP

GLARE. 「I−I AM JUST
JOKING.」 「T−THIS

IS JUST MEAN!」
CHIZURU−SAN POUTED

AND TURNED AWAY WITH A
HUFF. UGH,

B−BUT...! TO THINK EVEN
HER ANGRY
GESTURES ARE CUTE...
WHAT A SNEAKY PERSON!

「KOICHI−SAN, YOU
SOMETIMES SAY SUCH

MEAN THINGS!」 「I AM JUST
JOKING,

CHIZURU−SAN!」 SHE
CROSSED HER ARMS AND
LET OUT A HUFF. 「I
AM SORR−Y, I WAS JUST

KIDDING!」 「NO, I GET IT
NOW! YOU FIND

ME SO
SCARY THAT YOU EVEN
DREAM ABOUT
ME!」 「OH, COME

ON−THERE・S NO WAY A
DREAM

FEATURING YOU WOULD BE A
BAD DREAM!」

JUST THEN, CHIZURU GAVE
A

LITTLE CHUCKLE AND
LOOKED

BACK AT ME. 「DOES
THAT... MEAN WHAT?」 SHE
SAID,
BRINGING HER FACE CLOSE
TO MINE. 「N−NO, WELL...」
SEEING ME FLUSTERED AND

TONGUE−TIED, CHIZURU
GIGGLED.

「GEEZ, IF YOU ARE JUST
GOING TO

APOLOGIZE, YOU SHOULD
NOT HAVE

SAID ANYTHING IN THE
FIRST PLACE.」 SHE GAVE
MY CHEEK A LITTLE

POKE WITH HER INDEX
FINGER. IN THAT INSTANT,
MY HEART GAVE A

SUDDEN THUMP, AND A
MOMENT LATER, MY CHEEKS BEGAN TO FLUSH.

「HEHE, REALLY,
KOICHI−SAN IS JUST

LIKE A BIG KID. OH,
HERE... YOU・VE GOT

BEDHEAD.」 CHIZURU−SAN・S
SLENDER FINGERS

SMOOTHED DOWN MY STRAY
HAIR. I FELT LIKE A

CHILD HAVING MY HEAD
PATTED, AND I COULD

NOT HELP BUT FEEL
INCREDIBLY EMBARRASSED.

EVEN THOUGH CHIZURU−SAN
IS PLENTY

CHILDLIKE HERSELF. I
MUMBLED INCOHERENTLY.

THE FIRST TIME I MET
THIS OLDER COUSIN OF
MINE WAS WHEN I WAS

ONLY ELEVEN... DURING
THE SUMMER

BREAK OF FIFTH GRADE.
CHIZURU−SAN

WAS FOURTEEN, IN HER
SECOND YEAR OF MIDDLE
SCHOOL. TO ME, WHO HAD

NOT YET HIT MY GROWTH
SPURT, SHE SEEMED LIKE SUCH A HUGE GIRL.

EVEN BACK THEN, SHE HAD
THIS KIND OF

PERSONALITY−SHE CALLED
ME 「KO−CHAN」 AND

DOTED ON ME LIKE A REAL
LITTLE BROTHER.

OF COURSE, I, TOO, HAD
GROWN COMPLETELY

ATTACHED TO MY BEAUTIFUL
AND KIND OLDER

COUSIN. I THINK THE
REASON SHE TREATS

ME LIKE A CHILD IS THAT
THIS IMAGE FROM BACK
THEN HAS BECOME
INGRAINED.

BEFORE I KNEW IT, I HAD
GROWN TALLER THAN HER,
AND SHE HAD STARTED

CALLING ME 「KOICHI−SAN」
TOO. BUT IN ESSENCE, MY
RELATIONSHIP WITH

CHIZURU−SAN HAS NOT
CHANGED AT ALL.

JUST AS IT WAS BACK
THEN... DURING

THE SUMMER VACATION OF
FIFTH GRADE,

I AM STILL 「KO−CHAN」 IN
FRONT OF HER.

「N−NO, WELL... AHAHA,
AHAHAHA...」 I DECIDED TO

LAUGH IT OFF. I COULD
NOT BRING MYSELF TO TALK

ABOUT A DREAM LIKE THAT.
IF IT HAD BEEN A MORE

ABSTRACT DREAM, I MIGHT
HAVE JUST GONE AHEAD

AND ACCEPTED THE
DIAGNOSIS, BUT THIS ONE
WAS
PARTICULARLY STRAIGHTFORWARD.
THERE WAS NO POINT

IN NEEDLESSLY
HUMILIATING MYSELF. IT
WOULD

BE LIKE CONFESSING,
「THIS IS MY TRUE
NATURE.」

「IT・S FINE. IT WAS NOT A
MEANINGFUL

DREAM ANYWAY,
AND BESIDES, I CAN
BARELY

REMEMBER IT ANYMORE.」 I
LIED, RUBBING

MY EYES WITH THE BACK OF
MY HAND AS THEY

STILL WERE NOT FULLY
AWAKE. LYING TO

CHIZURU−SAN−NO MATTER
HOW TRIVIAL−FELT

STRANGELY A BIT WRONG.
「...I SEE.」
CHIZURU−SAN・S EXPRESSION
SOFTENED SLIGHTLY.

「SOMEONE ONCE SAID THAT
DREAMS ARE THE
PATH TO THE UNCONSCIOUS
WORLD...」 「I・VE

HEARD
THAT BEFORE,
TOO. I BELIEVE IT WAS

IN
A PSYCHOLOGY LECTURE AT
UNIVERSITY

OR
SOMETHING... FREUD,
MAYBE? NO,

WAS IT JUNG?」 「THAT・S
RIGHT. SIGMUND
FREUD.」 BATHED IN

THE
PIERCING MORNING
LIGHT, CHIZURU−SAN
GAVE A FAINT SMILE.

「APPARENTLY, THE HUMAN
BRAIN−WHICH IS NATURALLY
DIVIDED INTO A

DIVISION OF LABOUR−SHUTS
DOWN ITS VARIOUS
ACTIVITIES IN SEPARATE

PARTS WHILE WE SLEEP.
FOR EXAMPLE...」 HER
INDEX FINGER GAVE THE

RIGHT SIDE OF MY HEAD A
LIGHT POKE. 「WHEN ONLY
THE PART OF THE

BRAIN RESPONSIBLE FOR
MEMORY IS AWAKE, YOU
MIGHT SUDDENLY HAVE A

DREAM ABOUT THE PAST...」
HER

FINGER SHIFTED UP
SLIGHTLY. IT FELT

A LITTLE PLEASANT. 「AND
WHEN ONLY

THE PART OF THE BRAIN
GOVERNING

VISION IS AWAKE, FRAGMENTED AND
DISCONNECTED IMAGES
SURFACE.」

I FELT AS THOUGH
CHIZURU−SAN・S
EYES−USUALLY VACANT−WERE
NOW

RADIATING AN
INTELLECTUAL GLOW.

PERHAPS IT WAS THE
DIFFERENCE IN OUR

ACADEMIC BACKGROUNDS
THAT MADE IT SEEM SO.
DESPITE BEING ONLY THREE

YEARS APART, SHE SEEMED FAR MORE LIKE A SENIOR.
「WHEN THE PARTS

OF US THAT WORRY ABOUT
SOCIAL STANDING OR
APPEARANCES ARE ASLEEP,

AND ONLY THE PARTS
GOVERNING DESIRE AND
EMOTION ARE AWAKE, THE

TRUE FEELINGS WE USUALLY
SUPPRESS THROUGH REASON
MANIFEST AS

DREAMS.
DREAMS TRULY ARE THE PATH

TO THE UNCONSCIOUS, ARE
NOT THEY?」

「...SO, A ・DANGEROUS
DREAM・ MEANS A PERSON・S

TRUE FEELINGS−THOSE THAT
HAVE SLIPPED

BEYOND THE CONFINES OF
REASON?」 「IT SYMBOLIZES

THAT.」 HMM, CLOSE CALL.
I AM GLAD I DID

NOT MENTION IT AFTER
ALL. IF THE DAY CAME

WHEN CHIZURU−SAN
EXPLAINED THAT SUCH MACABRE

TASTES WERE MY TRUE
FEELINGS, I DO NOT

THINK I WOULD HAVE BEEN
ABLE TO RECOVER.

「SO, IS IT ACTUALLY
EMBARRASSING TO LET
OTHERS

HEAR ABOUT YOUR
DREAMS...?」 「...I
SUPPOSE SO.

IT・S ESSENTIALLY THE
SAME AS INDIRECTLY
REVEALING

YOUR TRUE FEELINGS. THAT
SAID, WHEN PEOPLE TALK
ABOUT THEIR DREAMS TO OTHERS,
THEY USUALLY EMBELLISH

THE CONTENT TO MAKE IT
ACCEPTABLE IF
OVERHEARD.」

「WELL, I GUESS IT REALLY
IS EMBARRASSING...」

「STILL, DEPENDING ON THE
PERSON, THEY CAN TELL.」

THAT・S WHEN IT SUDDENLY
HIT ME. 「HUH? THEN

CHIZURU−SAN, WHO TRIED
TO GET ME TO TALK

ABOUT
MY DREAMS...」 「AH, OH
NO.」 CHIZURU

STUCK OUT HER TONGUE. IT
WAS A QUIRK OF

HERS, COMPLETELY AT ODDS
WITH HER BEAUTIFUL

APPEARANCE. THAT
CHILDLIKE HABIT−WHICH
MIGHT EVEN BE SEEN AS
SOMEWHAT UNREFINED−WAS,

WHEN CHIZURU DID IT,
SIMPLY ADORABLE.

「WHAT・S WITH YOU,
CHIZURU−SAN?! YOU ARE

PLAYING SOME KIND OF
LEADING QUESTION!」
「N−NO,

WELL, UM... I JUST
THOUGHT, AS YOUR COUSIN,

MAYBE I SHOULD
DISCREETLY LISTEN TO
YOUR

WORRIES TOO,
KOICHI−SAN...」
CHIZURU−SAN FORCED

A STRAINED SMILE. 「MIND
YOUR OWN BUSINESS!

IF
THAT・S THE CASE, BEFORE
YOU LISTEN TO

MINE, TELL ME ABOUT YOUR
DREAMS FIRST!」

「UH, WELL... LATELY,
MAYBE BECAUSE

I・VE BEEN SLEEPING SO
SOUNDLY, I

OFTEN DO NOT REMEMBER
THE DETAILS...」

「NO
FAIR! JEEZ, ENOUGH. I
GET IT. I

UNDERSTAND.
WHAT KIND OF PERSON
CHIZURU−SAN IS.」
「AHHH, IT・S TRUE!」 OF
COURSE, I WAS NOT
ACTUALLY ANGRY. I JUST

ENJOY TEASING
CHIZURU−SAN LIKE THIS.

STILL... AT THE RISK OF
